introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.commitment: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our development framework, tools, and services.
introduction.agreement: you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our services.

provided.title: 2.1 Information You Provide
provided.accountDesc: Name, email address, password, and profile information when you create an account
provided.usageDesc: Information about how you use our services, including features accessed and time spent
provided.communicationDesc: Messages, feedback, and support requests you send to us
provided.paymentDesc: Billing details and payment method information for premium features
provided.projectDesc: Code, configurations, and project files you create using our framework

automatic.title: 2.2 Automatically Collected Information
automatic.deviceDesc: IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers
automatic.analyticsDesc: Pages visited, features used, and interaction patterns
automatic.performanceDesc: Error logs, performance metrics, and system diagnostics
automatic.cookiesDesc: Small data files stored on your device to improve your experience

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use the information we collect to:
usage.provide: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
usage.process: Process transactions and manage your account
usage.send: Send you important updates, security alerts, and support messages
usage.respond: Respond to your comments, questions, and support requests
usage.analyze: Analyze usage patterns to enhance user experience
usage.detect: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats
usage.comply: Comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms
usage.develop: Develop new features and services based on user feedback

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

providers.title: 4.1 Service Providers
providers.intro: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, such as:
providers.payment: Payment processors for billing and transactions

legal.title: 4.2 Legal Requirements
legal.desc: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or government request, or to protect our rights, property, or safety.

business.title: 4.3 Business Transfers
business.desc: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of the business transaction.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
security.encryption: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
security.training: Employee training on data protection practices
security.incident: Incident response and breach notification procedures

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.intro: We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. The retention period varies based on the type of information:
retention.accountDesc: Retained while your account is active and for a reasonable period after deletion
retention.usageDesc: Retained for analytics and service improvement purposes
retention.paymentDesc: Retained as required by financial regulations
retention.communicationDesc: Retained for customer support and legal compliance

rights.title: 7. Your Rights and Choices
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

access.title: 7.1 Access and Portability
access.desc: You can request access to your personal information and receive a copy in a portable format.

correction.title: 7.2 Correction and Update
correction.desc: You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.

deletion.title: 7.3 Deletion
deletion.desc: You can request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal requirements.

restriction.title: 7.4 Restriction and Objection
restriction.desc: You can request restriction of processing or object to certain uses of your information.

marketing.title: 7.5 Marketing Communications
marketing.desc: You can opt out of marketing communications at any time using the unsubscribe link or contacting us directly.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and provide personalized content. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.

types.title: 8.1 Types of Cookies We Use
types.essentialDesc: Required for basic functionality and security
types.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors use our platform
types.marketingDesc: Used for targeted advertising and content

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.desc: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

children.title: 10. Children's Privacy
children.desc: Our services are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

eu.title: 13. Legal Basis for Processing (EU Users)
eu.intro: For users in the European Union, our legal basis for processing your personal information includes:
eu.consentDesc: When you explicitly agree to our processing
eu.contractDesc: To provide our services under our terms
eu.legitimateDesc: To improve our services and prevent fraud
eu.legalDesc: To comply with applicable laws and regulations

california.title: 14. California Privacy Rights (CCPA)
california.desc: California residents have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), including the right to know what personal information we collect and how we use it, the right to delete personal information, and the right to opt out of the sale of personal information.

footer.effective: This Privacy Policy is effective as of
footer.remain: and will remain in effect except with respect to any changes in its provisions in the future.
